sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-84.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 84 was established by Ordinance No. 14947, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 4, 1975. Ordinance No. 14947 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. Ordinance No. 14947 was amended by Resolution No. 77-1115, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 25, 1977; Ordinance No. 22187, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 14, 1994; and Ordinance No. 22777, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 12, 1996. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 14947; 22187; 22777; 25423; Res. 77-1115)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-84.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 84 is established on property generally located at the northwest corner of Royal Lane and the Dallas North Tollway. The size of PD 84 is approximately 5.556 acres. (Ord. Nos. 14947; 25423; 27875; 30492)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-84.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article. In this article, SCHOOL FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION means a school for students with learning disabilities or attention deficit disorder.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51.
(c)This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423; 30492) SEC. 51P- 84.103.1.EXHIBITS. The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:
(1)Exhibit 84A: development/conceptual plan.
(2)Exhibit 84B: landscape plan. (Ord. 30492)

sections.title: Development/Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-84.104.DEVELOPMENT/CONCEPTUAL PLAN. A development/conceptual plan (Exhibit 84A) for each phase of development within the PD is attached to and made a part of the PD ordinance. Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/conceptual plan. In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development/conceptual plan, the provisions of this article control. For those portions of the Property shown in concept on the development/conceptual plan, a development plan must be approved by the city plan commission before issuance of any building permit. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 22777; 25423)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-84.105.USES.
(a)Main uses. The only main uses permitted are a private school and a school for special education.
(b)Accessory uses. As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51-4.217. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423; 30492)

sections.title: Use Regulations And Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-84.106.USE REGULATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS. The use regulations and development standards in the MF-3 District apply to this PD, with the following exceptions:
(1)Height. No structure may exceed a maximum allowable height of 36 feet as measured from the highest point on the structure, including all structures listed in Section 51- 4.408(a)(2).
(2)Stories. The number of stories is limited to two. provided.
(3)Off-street parking. A minimum of 105 off-street parking spaces must be
(4)Setbacks.
(A)Area I. The building line setback from Royal Lane is 95 feet, as shown on the development/conceptual plan.
(B)Area II. The building line setback from Royal Lane is 145 feet and 95 feet, as shown on the development/conceptual plan.
(C)Practice field netting. Practice field netting and support poles may be located in a required front, side, or rear yard setback.
(5)Landscaping.
(A)Landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 84B). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.
(B)Landscaping must be installed before issuance of a certificate of occupancy for Area II. growing condition.
(C)Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy,
(6)Lot coverage. Maximum allowable lot coverage is 28 percent.
(7)Floor area. Maximum building square footage permitted on the site is limited to 57,942 square feet for Area I, and 28,787 square feet for Area II.
(8)Ingress and egress. Ingress and egress to and from Royal Lane is limited to a one-way entrance and a one-way exit as shown on the development/conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 22777; 25423; 27875; 30492)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text: SEC. 51P-84.107.LIGHTING. All lights, except security lights, must be turned off by 10:30 p.m. every evening. Night lighting must be constructed so that light will be reflected downward and not toward any nearby residential property. No lighting of the areas identified as “recreation fields” and “playing fields” on the development/conceptual plan is permitted. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423)

sections.title: Drainage Area
sections.text: SEC. 51P-84.108.DRAINAGE AREA. Existing trees along the flood easement area and in the area north of the flood easement area, as shown on the development/conceptual plan, must remain. No construction is permitted on the north side of the flood easement, however, the north side of the flood easement can be used for recreational and open space purposes. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423; 30492)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-84.109.SCREENING.
(a)A solid fence or hedge must be maintained in the locations shown on the development/conceptual plan along Royal Lane between the south property line and the area identified as “Existing Parking Area” on the development/conceptual plan.
(b)A solid screening fence along the western and northern boundaries of the Property must be maintained in the locations shown on the development/conceptual plan at heights of six feet and eight feet.
(c)All other screening must be provided prior to the issuance of a building permit on Area II.
(d)The existing fence and 36-foot pole and field netting along the eastern property line adjacent to the Dallas North Tollway must be maintained. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423; 27875 30492)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-84.110.SIGNS. Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423) SEC. 51P-84.110.1.ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS. See Article VI. (Ord. 30492)

sections.title: Additonal Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-84.111.ADDITONAL PROVISIONS.
(a)The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.
(b)Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423; 26102; 30492)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-84.112.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.
(a)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.
(b)The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22187; 25423; 30492)
